functionalReqs: Classify text into positive / negative / neutral with a confidence
Real-time API for support tickets; batch jobs for review backlogs
hints: Do you need to train a model at all? Compare an off-the-shelf LLM prompt, a pre-trained classifier and fine-tuning.
Labels: star ratings are weak labels for reviews. What about tickets?

Fine-tune a small multilingual transformer (e.g., distilled) on weakly labelled reviews plus a human-labelled set; export to ONNX and serve on CPU with batching for the API; batch inference on a schedule for backlogs; evaluate with macro-F1 per language; monitor confidence and class distribution.
nonFunctionalReqs: Batch path processes millions of reviews per day cheaply
problemStatement: Design a **sentiment analysis service** that tags product reviews and support tickets as positive, negative or neutral, for dashboards and for routing angry customers to agents faster.
title: Design a Sentiment Analysis Service
